title: Senior architect for identity management, directing product strategy for a ~20-person team
summary: I joined Philips Innovation Campus in Bengaluru in September 2018 as senior architect for the identity management platform used across health informatics products, directing its product strategy and growth for a team of about 20.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a role change, not an intervention.
the_call: Move from payments engineering into healthcare software, where quality and compliance carry more weight, and take ownership of a platform's direction rather than one piece of it.
what_i_did: As senior architect, directed product strategy and growth for the identity management platform and its team of about 20, and set up its quality and delivery pipeline in the first months.
what_changed: Started the Philips chapter that led into company-wide software excellence work.

metrics.label: people on the identity management team I directed
metrics.context: As senior architect; team size and scope are my own recollection, not independently documented.
